summary: Elevate your financial expertise with our Data Analytics training. Learn to monitor markets and make data-driven decisions for better investment outcomes.
lede: Financial market monitoring analytics helps finance, treasury, investment, policy and risk professionals turn market data into decision-ready signals. Participants practice defining monitoring questions, selecting and checking indicators, analyzing trends in rates, foreign exchange and inflation, and presenting stress signals through dashboards, alerts and concise briefings.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who are responsible for monitoring financial markets and making data-driven decisions.
audience: Central bank, regulator, and policy staff
modules: Market Data Sources and Data Quality Control
Interest Rate Analytics for Monitoring and Risk
FX Market Analytics and Currency Pressure Signals
Liquidity, Credit Conditions, and Stress Indicators
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial markets and data analysis. Familiarity with Excel and basic statistical concepts is recommended.
